_comment: BCP 1979 Ps 23 pointed by Venite editors using structural conventions only (dot for cadence start, asterisk caesura, ~8% dactylic exceptions, intonation on v1 only). These are our own editorial choices; no specific pointings from any copyrighted psalter were reproduced. Word indices are from the END of each half-verse, 0-based (0 = last word). Ambiguity notes: v4 final cadence 'comfort me' treated as dactylic (COM-fort-me, finalAccent on 'comfort'); v5 mediant 'trouble me' treated as dactylic on the mediant cadence (the schema's `ending` field only captures the final cadence, so the v5 mediant-dactylic character is left for the renderer/tone to handle via abrupt-mediation rules); v6 first half cadence falls naturally on 'life' (monosyllabic).
